# Daily Briefing – Sunday 2 August 2026

Yesterday was a serious effort — 31km in 183 minutes at 147bpm average is a strong long run, and with nearly 40,000 steps your body put in a full day's work. The 4,954 kcal burn against a 2,300 kcal target means you were running a significant deficit, so how you recover today really matters.

The good news is your body is handling it well. HRV at 116ms sits right at the top of your 100–118ms baseline, resting HR is an impressive 43bpm, and stress is low at 37/100. These are genuinely excellent recovery markers — you've absorbed that long run better than most would.

Today's priority is eating aggressively back toward your targets. Aim for your full 175g protein and don't be shy about carbohydrates — after yesterday's deficit, under-fuelling now will cost you more than the extra calories.
